description: pvOps is a Python library for analysing operations and maintenance records from photovoltaic plants. It combines text maintenance logs, current-voltage curves and power-production time series, with cleaning and visualization functions that support empirical reliability studies. The site coverage and observation period depend on a plant operator’s files; the software does not publish a complete fleet dataset. The public repository and package instructions contain BSD 3-Clause-style terms with a US Government rights notice in the own licence file. Its prepared data can help estimate failure patterns and repair effects for PV generation and resilience simulations. A caveat is that log terminology and sensor quality differ among plants, so a merged analysis needs careful provenance and validation. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own README and licence were inspected without obtaining private maintenance data or running the package.
